findings.detail: OneCare Media revolving credit line issuer_name should be localized to the clean issuer, not the full debt-investment path with terms.
The Smilist Management revolving credit line issuer_name should be localized to the clean issuer, not the full debt-investment path with terms.
The Smilist Management term loan issuer_name should be localized to the clean issuer, not the full debt-investment path with terms.

rationale: C206 is confirmed. The flagged stored issuer_name values are not clean issuers; they concatenate debt investment category, issuer, instrument, industry, spread, interest rate, and maturity. In the raw June 30, 2023 SOI, those terms are separate columns and the portfolio company cell only contains the issuer plus instrument, proving a wrapper/extraction localization failure for the three flagged cells.
